_help: Call set (C4). Copy to calls/sets/<SET>.json (T = training, S1..S5 = experimental). Up to 5 calls; no location repeated within a set or across one participant's sets. priority 1 = most urgent (agent visits by priority). scenario_code = what the operator finds at the call (e.g. car_in_water, on_roof; vocabulary to be set). condition = injury / state details (to be defined). truth = ground truth for scoring the report (7.1). hazards and prompts are placeholders for G1 and H5.
